title: DOBB: Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance under State Uncertainty and Heterogeneous Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-based decentralized collision avoidance must remain reliable under state-estimation uncertainty and heterogeneous agent dynamics. Existing methods typically address these factors through training-domain variation or by exposing uncertainty and capability estimates to the policy at runtime. However, both leave the policy to infer how these quantities should alter the physical separation required for safe interaction, which can couple collision-avoidance behavior to relationships learned from the training distribution. We introduce the Dynamic Oriented Bounding Box (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps the current state estimate, uncertainty, and agent-specific response characteristics into a dynamic, direction-dependent safety margin. translated_title: DOBB：面向状态不确定性与异构动力学下多智能体避碰的动态定向包围盒
translated_abstract: 基于学习的去中心化避碰方法必须在状态估计不确定性和异构智能体动力学条件下保持可靠。现有方法通常通过训练域变化，或在运行时将不确定性与能力估计直接暴露给策略来处理这些因素。然而，这两种方式都需要策略自行推断这些量应如何改变安全交互所需的物理间隔，这可能使避碰行为与从训练分布中学到的关系耦合在一起。我们提出了动态定向包围盒（DOBB），这是一种在线几何表示方法，可将当前状态估计、不确定性以及智能体特定的响应特性映射为动态的、依赖方向的安全边距。我们推导出能够联合表征智能体DOBB之间相对构型与交互严重程度的几何特征，并配套设计了相应的奖励函数……
tldr: 提出动态定向包围盒（DOBB），一种在线几何表示方法，将状态估计不确定性、异构动力学及智能体响应特性转化为动态且依赖方向的安全边距，从而提升多智能体避碰在不确定条件下的可靠性。
en_tdlr: We propose Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps state-estimation uncertainty, heterogeneous dynamics, and agent-specific response characteristics into dynamic, direction-dependent safety margins for reliable multi-agent collision avoidance.
